House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Energy Finance and Policy

additions: (12) a new or modified electric generating facility that is primarily intended to provide power to a data center if the electric generating facility complies with section 216B.1691, subdivision 2g.
(1) "data center" means a physical location that stores a large group of networked computer servers that are used to remotely store, process, or distribute large amounts of digital data; and
